articles.title: Overnight strikes in Yemen kill at least 1 person and injure 9, and other Mideast news
articles.description: Overnight strikes in Yemen have hit a gas station and an oil facility, killing at least one person and injuring nine others. Residents and Houthi rebels reported the attacks on Tuesday. The strikes caused extensive damage and panic in Sanaa, the capital. The Houthi-run health ministry blames Saudi Arabia for the attacks, but the claims are unverified. The strikes come amid renewed fighting between the Houthis and Saudi-backed forces. Meanwhile, in Iran, a top security official claimed the war has "wrecked" the United States. He urged Washington to accept Tehran's demands to end the conflict.
